**0.10.0: a cleaner look, and the floating mic keeps your line breaks.**

- The app's screens now use the Hebrish look from hebrish.app: the warm paper background, the green accent, the Hebrish logo (it was showing as a plain green square), headings in the Hebrish typeface and grouped settings on the home screen. Dark mode follows the same palette. The keyboard and the floating mic look as before.
- The floating mic now pastes the transcript at your cursor instead of rewriting the whole text field. The field no longer jumps around while text goes in, and a line break or blank line before the cursor stays where it is. The transcript is left on the clipboard after a take. (Also in 0.9.1, which went out on GitHub only.)
- Not yet tested on a phone; the new screens were checked on an Android 14 emulator. arm64-v8a only. Android 9+. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
